content: PerformanceMonitor (drei) props: ms=250, iterations=10, threshold=0.75, factor=0.5, step=0.1, flipflops=Infinity, onIncline/onDecline/onChange/onFallback callbacks. The PerformanceMonitorApi passed to callbacks includes a factor (0-1). AdaptiveDpr (drei) reads state.performance.current via useThree and calls setDpr(current * initialDpr) — must be inside Canvas, works automatically when PerformanceMonitor is also inside Canvas. Standard pattern: <Canvas dpr={[1,2]}><PerformanceMonitor onDecline={...} onIncline={...}><GlassScene /><AdaptiveDpr /></PerformanceMonitor></Canvas>. The simplest approach for adaptive DPR: use PerformanceMonitor + AdaptiveDpr together, no manual setDpr needed.
